detail.longDescription: Feeling proud after succesfully setting up Immich with OpenTofu, Ansible and Docker on my Proxmox homelab without LLM assistance. I am relying on an Ansible Docker role that I configured using Claude Sonnet though, so it's only a partial win. Code can be found here: https:// code.loysharosen.com/loysharos en/homelab/src/branch/main # selfhosted # selfhost # selfhosting # proxmox # opentofu # ansible # docker
